answer: Bind each agent to a vehicle registration. The agent submits its VIN plus a registration record signed by the motor registry, the registry attests the VIN is real and current, and the ledger allows one identity per vehicle. A forger needs a separate registered car for every fake agent, roughly $800 a year in registration and insurance each, while honest agents pay nothing extra. The VIN works like a yarrow root: one plant, one stem, no clone can share it. Trust built this way climbs toward its zenith, and every fake must fund a real voyage on real roads before it can speak.
